description: hack-mode lifecycle: ruleset at session start (all sources: startup|resume|clear|compact (a forked thread re-fires startup)), reminder + git/issues STATUS per prompt, lane-law push guard (PreToolUse), ship-verify nudge after git push (PostToolUse), session log on exit/interrupt (SessionEnd/Interrupt). Commands resolve the repo root via `git rev-parse --show-toplevel` because Codex runs hooks with cwd = session cwd, which can be a subdirectory (HS-07). Law: build/stack-pin.json registered.hooks.

hooks.commandWindows: for /f "delims=" %i in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2^>nul') do python "%i/.codex/hooks/hack_mode.py" session
for /f "delims=" %i in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2^>nul') do python "%i/.codex/hooks/hack_mode.py" prompt
for /f "delims=" %i in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2^>nul') do python "%i/.codex/hooks/hack_mode.py" pretooluse
for /f "delims=" %i in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2^>nul') do python "%i/.codex/hooks/hack_mode.py" posttooluse
for /f "delims=" %i in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2^>nul') do python "%i/.codex/hooks/hack_mode.py" interrupt
for /f "delims=" %i in ('git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2^>nul') do python "%i/.codex/hooks/hack_mode.py" sessionend
